about: The log contract for every secondhand program. Writers: log/index.js and log/secondhand_log.py. Checker: spec/log.mjs. How to use it: log/README.md.

session.start.logs: A program started: one app launch, one server boot, one job or agent process. Carries the build version and the random seed.

session.end.logs: The program stopped on purpose. A session with no end crashed or is still running.

ui.show.logs: What the person now sees: the screen, its state and the ids of what is on it.

user.input.logs: Every tap, choice and typed value. A choice goes in value. Typed words go in text, which is masked.

request.start.logs: A request reached the server: an app call or a site's webhook.

state.change.logs: A primitive changed state (product/primitives.md), when no more specific event covers it. The state before goes in was.

item.action.logs: A step in an item's life, named as in spec/lifecycle.mjs. spec/replay.mjs checks these against the model.

job.state.logs: A Job moved to a new state.

job.stage.logs: Progress inside a running Job, the stage the app shows while it waits.

call.start.logs: An outside call is about to be made, with its input.

call.end.logs: That call returned or threw, with its result or error. A model call adds model, tokens_in, tokens_out and cost_usd.

agent.start.logs: An agent loop started, with its goal.

agent.step.logs: One turn of the loop: what the agent chose to do and why. Its tool calls are call lines with the same run.

agent.end.logs: The loop stopped, with its result or error.

decision.open.logs: Something needs the person: a Decision was raised, with its options and why.

decision.answer.logs: The person's tap on a Decision. Add edited and ms_on_card when known.

decision.close.logs: A Decision closed without a tap: stale, expired or replaced.

error.logs: Something failed outside a call: a caught exception, a rejected promise, a crash handler.

note.logs: A free line for debugging. Use a named event when one fits.
